$seq._comment: expiresAt is a fixed far-future epoch ms, not $ago (which only goes backward): a fixture ticket never needs to look freshly minted, only never-expired. Four distinct tickets, one per mint in this page load (Deck settings-browser.js: tap, Refresh, Add another device after Remove, Add another device from connected), so a stale-ring regression (the reviewer's MEDIUM on wink-card.js, 28 Sep) shows up as the SAME ring redrawn twice, not just as a ring existing. Real base64url shapes (8 random bytes each, deck/js/phone-code.js's ticketToBytes decodes this), not English words with a shared prefix: an earlier version of these four shared a long common prefix, which decoded to the SAME first 8 bytes for all of them (ticketToBytes only reads the first 8 decoded bytes) and made every ring look identical regardless of which ticket was live, masking the very regression this fixture exists to catch.
